title: Grateful Dead Live at Strand Lyceum on 1972-05-23
lineage: Reels > Apogee Mini ME 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC(monitoring) > Wavelab 5.0(dithered to 16/44)>CD Edited and Mastered by Jamie Waddell on the GEMS Edit Station in Wavelab 6.1 with UA DSP FLAC Level8 in TLH MetaData in Tag and Rename

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a top‑tier ’72 performance with sparkling versions of Mexicali Blues, Good Lovin’, Dark Star and more; the recording is clear, well‑speed‑corrected and highly listenable.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as a “top tier ’72” concert with standout renditions of Mexicali Blues, Good Lovin', Dark Star, Morning Dew, Sugar Magnolia, Comes A Time and Uncle John’s. Reviewers note the soundboard source sounds perfect and may be speed‑corrected, delivering a crisp listening experience. Overall the energy is high and Jerry Garcia’s playing is described as primed.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, enthusiastic reviews highlight both stellar musical performance and clean recording; other comments are about accessibility rather than quality, so the combined impression is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as “pretty perfect” and possibly speed‑corrected; no major flaws or dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic set with strong transitions; the show maintains a high‑energy momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “primed” and delivering sparkling guitar work.
